name: vault
description: A second brain in an Obsidian vault, as plain Markdown that works with Obsidian closed: /vault sets up a PARA or Zettelkasten vault (or adopts yours), copies handoffs and research briefs in with links to their project, keeps a daily note, hints notes that match each prompt (qmd vectors and reranker through its daemon, or ripgrep), and has save, ask, inbox and review
